metadata.name: player_state
metadata.description: Breathless player state: per-wallet equipment, synthesis and aquarium progress, paid for by burning PEARL

instructions.name: buy_boat
docs: Buys `level` of a boat piece at the ProgressConfig price, burning the
PEARL in the same instruction (the boat twin of `buy_upgrade`). `level`
must be exactly the next one, so a resent or doubled transaction can
never buy two levels. Creates the owner's Progress on first use (the
owner pays its rent). Nothing ever lowers a boat level: a shark bite
only resets the dive gear (equipment.ts DIVE_GEAR_SLOTS).

accounts.name: owner
docs: Signs, pays the burn and (on first use) the Progress rent.

accounts.name: progress
docs: created and written by hand in load_or_create_progress / store_progress.

instructions.name: buy_upgrade
docs: Buys the next level of a slot at the Config price (main.ts buyNextUpgrade).

instructions.name: craft
docs: Crafts one recipe (synthesis.ts craft): needs the materials, burns the
recipe cost, consumes the materials, adds one crafted item.

instructions.name: feed
docs: One pour of food over a school (aquarium.ts feedSchool): every listed
fish that is neither fully grown nor still in its cooldown grows by the
food's weight, and the food's price is burned once. If no listed fish
can eat, the whole call fails and nothing is burned.

instructions.name: forget_fish
docs: Drops growth entries for fish the client says are gone (sold or burned)
and refunds the freed rent to the owner. Unknown keys are ignored.

instructions.name: init_player
docs: Creates the player's state and aquarium. The owner signs and pays rent.
Everyone starts from zero: gear at Lv1, default paths, the default materials.

instructions.name: init_progress_config
docs: Creates the `ProgressConfig` (boat prices, ship and map thresholds). Config admin only.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates the config. Only the program's upgrade authority may call it,
so nobody can front-run the deploy and take the admin seat.

instructions.name: record_catch
docs: The oracle (Config.oracle, the market wallet) records one banked fish:
its value is added to the owner's lifetime banked value (which unlocks
ships and maps and never goes down) and the best single catch is kept.
Idempotent per fish: `fish` (the fish's seed, the u32 of its 8-hex id,
zero-extended) goes into the sorted catch log at the end of the
Progress account. A fish already in the log is a no-op that succeeds,
so a retried mint never double-counts and never fails the mint it rides
with. Creates the Progress on first use; `payer` funds its rent and the
8 bytes of rent each new fish adds (in the cosigned mint tx that is the
game's session key, the fee payer, so no extra signature is needed).

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Must be Config.oracle (the market wallet). Signs, pays nothing.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the Progress rent and its growth; any signer (the mint tx's fee payer).

accounts.name: progress
docs: created, grown and written by hand.

instructions.name: set_oracle
docs: Replaces the oracle (the market wallet that records catches in later phases). Admin only.

instructions.name: set_path
docs: Chooses a slot's module path (equipment.ts setEquipmentPath): free, any
number of times, only once the slot is Lv2+, sonar has none. The owner
or the session key signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner, or the player's registered session key.

instructions.name: set_progress_config
docs: Replaces the boat prices and the ship / map thresholds. Config admin only.

instructions.name: set_session
docs: Sets (or clears, with the default pubkey) the session key that may sign
non-paying events for this player. Owner only.

instructions.name: set_ship
docs: Sails a shipyard ship (ships.ts equip): free, any ship whose threshold
the lifetime banked value has reached. Owner only. Ship 0 needs no call.

instructions.name: shark_bite
docs: A shark bite (equipment.ts resetDiveGear): every dive slot back to Lv1
and every path back to the default. PEARL, materials and crafted items
are untouched. The owner or the session key signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner, or the player's registered session key.

instructions.name: synth_upgrade
docs: Upgrades a slot at the synthesis station (main.ts synthUpgrade): one
composite plate plus the station's own fee buys the next level.

instructions.name: update_prices
docs: Replaces every price table at once. Admin only.

fields.name: entries
docs: Sorted by key, so lookups are a binary search.

fields.name: admin
docs: May change prices and the oracle. Set to the upgrade authority at init.

fields.name: oracle
docs: The market wallet that records catches (phase 2).

fields.name: pearl_mint
docs: The PEARL mint every payment burns.

fields.name: token_program
docs: The token program that owns the PEARL mint.

fields.name: fed
docs: Fish that grew.

fields.name: entries
docs: Entries in the growth table afterwards.

fields.name: key
docs: The fish's 8-byte key (the client's choice: fish id or asset-id prefix).

fields.name: growth_milli
docs: Growth units x1000, capped at max_growth_milli.

fields.name: food
docs: The food it last ate (its cooldown multiplier applies to the next feed).

fields.name: last_fed
docs: Unix seconds of the last accepted feed; 0 = never.

fields.name: flags
docs: Bit flags, all 0 in phase 1 (phase 2: in-dive, etc.).

fields.name: session
docs: Optional delegate for non-paying events; the default pubkey means none.

fields.name: levels
docs: Level per slot (rod, reel, net, fins, tank, lamp, sonar), 1..=3.

fields.name: paths
docs: Path per slot (rod, reel, net, fins, tank, lamp), 0 = default.

fields.name: materials
docs: scale, fiber, scrap, crystal.

fields.name: crafted
docs: bait, composite.

fields.name: best_value
docs: Best catch value, recorded by the oracle in phase 2.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zeroed space for later fields (dive start/end, counters).

types.name: PriceTable
docs: Every price and rule number the program reads. Amounts are PEARL base units
(the mint has 0 decimals, so 1 unit = 1 PEARL).

fields.name: upgrade
docs: `[slot][level - 1]`: PEARL to buy that level. Level 1 is the starting gear and must be 0.

fields.name: synth_upgrade
docs: `[slot][current level - 1]`: the synthesis station's fee for Lv1->2 and Lv2->3.

fields.name: recipe_cost
docs: PEARL per craft, per recipe.

fields.name: recipe_needs
docs: `[recipe][material]`: materials one craft consumes.

fields.name: starting_materials
docs: Materials a new player starts with (DEFAULT_SYNTHESIS).

fields.name: food_price
docs: PEARL per pour, per food.

fields.name: food_growth_milli
docs: Growth units per feed, x1000 (growthMultiplier).

fields.name: food_cooldown_milli
docs: Cooldown multiplier of the food a fish last ate, x1000 (feedCooldownMultiplier).

fields.name: feed_cooldown_ms
docs: Base cooldown between feeds of one fish, in ms (FEED_COOLDOWN_MS).

fields.name: max_growth_milli
docs: Growth cap, x1000 (MAX_GROWTH_UNITS).

types.name: Progress
docs: One per wallet (`["progress", owner]`), created by `buy_boat` or `record_catch`.
The fixed header below is followed by `catches` little-endian u64 fish
keys, sorted ascending (the catch log), so the account is
`Progress::SIZE + 8 * catches` bytes.

fields.name: lifetime_value
docs: Value of every fish ever banked (oracle-recorded). Never decreases.

fields.name: best_value
docs: The most valuable single fish recorded.

fields.name: catches
docs: Fish keys in the catch log.

fields.name: boat_levels
docs: Level per boat piece (bait, boat, boatSpeed, boatHull, boatDeck), 1..=3.

fields.name: ship
docs: The shipyard ship sailed (SHIPS index); 0 = the starter.

types.name: ProgressConfig
docs: Admin-set v2 rules. Separate from Config so the v1 Config layout never changes.

types.name: ProgressRules
docs: v2 rules, admin-set in `ProgressConfig`. Amounts are PEARL / banked value units.

fields.name: boat_prices
docs: `[boat slot][level - 1]`: PEARL to buy that level (upgrades.ts prices). Level 1 must be 0.

fields.name: ship_thresholds
docs: Lifetime banked value that unlocks each ship (ships.ts SHIPS[].threshold). Ship 0 must be 0.

fields.name: map_thresholds
docs: Lifetime banked value that unlocks each map (maps.ts unlockValue). Map 0 must be 0.

fields.name: by
docs: Who signed: the owner or the session key.

fields.name: dropped
docs: The levels before the reset.
